name: AlertDialog
description: Radix AlertDialog. Unlike ui:dialog it cannot be dismissed by clicking the overlay, and Cancel receives initial focus — both deliberate.
intent: Stop the user before something irreversible happens, and make cancelling the easy path.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

parts.name: AlertDialogDescription
parts.note: State exactly what is lost. This is the whole point of the component.

parts.name: AlertDialogCancel
parts.note: Receives initial focus. Never omit it.

parts.name: AlertDialogAction
parts.note: Label with the verb. Add destructive styling via className.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

keyboard: Enter — activate the focused control, which is Cancel by default
requiredAttributes: AlertDialogTitle and AlertDialogDescription are both required
accessibility.focusManagement: Cancel receives initial focus. Overlay clicks do not dismiss. Both differ from ui:dialog and are intentional.
notes: role="alertdialog" makes assistive technology announce it more assertively than a plain dialog.
Never move initial focus to AlertDialogAction. A stray Enter would then destroy data.
AlertDialogAction is not destructive-styled by default — add bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground yourself.

forbiddenUsage: Confirm button labelled OK or Yes
Initial focus on the confirm action
Collecting input inside an alert dialog
agentRules: Name the object in the title and the loss in the description.
Label the action with the verb — "Delete project", never "OK" or "Yes".
Never focus the confirm action by default.
Style AlertDialogAction as destructive when the action is destructive.
An AI agent must never open and confirm this flow without a human gesture.
